data.name: Rushda
data.gender_notes: Rushda is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A person who shows the way, a leader, a guide. The name Rushda carries the meaning “Guide, Leader” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Rushda usually hope their child will grow to embody guide, leader and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A seeker of truth and guidance, a righteous and pious woman.
data.etymology: Rushda belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Guide, Leader.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rushda total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_arabic.name: رشدة
in_arabic.meaning: هدايت يافته، رشد كرده، به راه راست هدايت شده
in_arabic.long_meaning: رشدة اسم مؤنث است و به معنای هدايت يافته، رشد كرده و به راه راست هدايت شده می باشد. اين نام از ريشه 'رشد' مشتق شده است كه در قرآن كريم نيز به آن اشاره شده است. رشد به معنای رسيدن به سن بلوغ و رشد عقلی و روحانی است.

in_urdu.name: رشدا
in_urdu.meaning: هدایت یافتہ، رشد کیا ہوا، راست راہ پر چلنے والا
in_urdu.long_meaning: رشدا ایک خوبصورت نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے هدایت یافتہ، رشد یافتہ اور راست راہ پر چلنے والا۔ یہ نام عربی زبان سے ماخوذ ہے اور قرآن مجید میں بھی اس کا ذکر آیا ہے۔ اس نام کا مطلب ہے کہ ایک شخص جو عقلی اور روحانی طور پر پختہ ہو گیا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: रुशदा
in_hindi.meaning: निर्देशित, विकसित, सही रास्ते पर चलने वाला
in_hindi.long_meaning: रुशदा एक सुंदर नाम है जिसका अर्थ है निर्देशित, विकसित और सही रास्ते पर चलने वाला। यह नाम अरबी भाषा से लिया गया है और कुरआन में भी इसका उल्लेख है। इस नाम का अर्थ है कि एक व्यक्ति जो बुद्धिमान और आध्यात्मिक रूप से परिपक्व हो गया है।

in_pashto.name: رښدا
in_pashto.meaning: لارښود, وده کړی, د حق لارې پر چلونکی
in_pashto.long_meaning: رښدا یو ښکلی نوم دی چې معنی یې لارښود, وده کړی او د حق لارې پر چلونکی دی. دا نوم د عربی ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی دی او په قرآن کریم کې هم ورته اشاره شوې ده. د دې نوم مطلب دا دی چې یو کس چې عقلي او روحاني توګه پختیا شوی دی.

in_english.name: Rushda
in_english.meaning: guided, grown, on the right path
in_english.long_meaning: Rushda is a lovely Islamic name for girls that means guided, grown, and on the right path. It originates from the Arabic root 'R-Sh-D', which conveys the sense of reaching intellectual and spiritual maturity. The name Rushda has been referenced in the Quran, emphasizing the significance of guidance and wisdom. In Islamic tradition, Rushda symbolizes a person's growth towards righteousness and spiritual enlightenment.

data.cultural_impact: The name Rushda holds a significant place in the Muslim community, as it represents the qualities of someone who is a beacon of guidance, a spiritual guide, and a leader. In various Islamic texts, it is mentioned that the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) guided his community with wisdom, kindness, and patience, much like the meaning of the name Rushda suggests. The importance of a guide or a leader is highly valued in Islamic culture, and the name Rushda serves as a reminder of the role such individuals play in our lives.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Rushda is often associated with the concept of guidance from Allah. It reminding us that Allah is the ultimate guide, and that He guides us on the right path towards Him. It also emphasizes the importance of guidance in our spiritual journey and encourages us to seek it, both from Allah and from the wise and knowledgeable individuals in our lives. Overall, the name Rushda inspires us to be guided, to be a guide, and to seek guidance from Allah.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Guide, Leader" symbolizes A person who shows the way, a leader, a guide.. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Rushda serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of guide, leader.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Rushda was a Persian poet and scholar of the 14th century. The name Rushda carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Rushda was a prominent figure in the Persian Golden Age of poetry and scholarship.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Rushda remains relevant in modern Muslim society, representing a bridge between traditional Islamic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Islamic names.
